requirements.text: librarian adds a tool to the catalogue
librarian lends a tool to a member with a due date
runs in a browser on the library's one shared laptop
no member data leaves the building: no hosted service or external call receives member data

rules: no stack recommended unless it blocks planning

member data stays in the building: no hosted database, third-party service or network call receives member data (a service that never sees member data, such as a font or a package registry, is not a violation)
verification includes a check that no member data leaves the building
the shared-laptop setting is reflected in sign-in and data handling (no per-person accounts are assumed)
